title: Receipt Issuance Gate
description: Implement the `lib/wdd/gate.py` module. This module takes an executed workorder and generates the cryptographically signed `receipt.json` using the keys from `wo-016`.

requirements.signing: Must use the agent's private key to sign the receipt payload.

acceptance_criteria: The generated receipt passes `wdd validate` and signature verification.
failure_modes: FAIL: Issuing a receipt without actually signing the payload.
